title: Activity from a channel
description: Activity for P1 submit_activity: the sender identity verified by the channel, chat, text, file_ref attachments, reply_to. The core computes the idempotency key from (channel, update id). Forwarded and quoted text is never a command (IDN-7). If the real sender is unknown (a message on behalf of a chat, an anonymous admin), sender.verified is false and the command is not executed. Code chooses the task type, not the text.

kind.description: message from a person through a channel; signal of an external system: from the monitoring adapter with the identity hook:monitor (MON-5), or from v0.2 from a source channel with the identity hook:<source> (ING-1 to ING-4); the fields of a signal are set by its event schema.

update_id.description: Update id at the messenger; together with the channel it is the idempotency key.

identity.description: Identity in the channel: telegram:<id>, api:<key_id>, hook:<source> or email:<address> (IDN-1).

verified.description: The channel verified the sender (signature, membership); false for a message on behalf of a chat or from an anonymous admin.

text.description: Message text; for the core this is untrusted data, except a command in the first word of a direct chat.

attachments.description: Attachments the channel has already put into the file store.

reply_to.description: Id of the message this replies to; the core uses it to look up a continuation (continues).

forwarded.description: The message is forwarded: not a command, the body gets personal_seen with source forward.

quoted.description: The message contains a quote: the quote is not a command, personal_seen source quote.

forwarded_from.description: Identity of the author of the forwarded text when the messenger shows it; the core writes the principal of that identity in the tenant into personal_subjects (AUD-5). Absent when the author is hidden or is not a person.

quoted_from.description: Identity of the author of the quoted text when the messenger shows it; the core writes the principal of that identity in the tenant into personal_subjects (AUD-5).

event.description: Only kind signal: the external event of the monitoring adapter (MON-5, MON-10) or, from v0.2, of a source channel (ING-1..4, spec/bindings/channels/webhook.md), its type and its data by the event data schema. For the monitoring adapter the channel is the adapter target, the chat a direct chat with the external id monitor, the update id the idempotency part of the event; for a source channel the chat is a direct chat with the external id of the source and the update id the delivery id. The core does not trust the type and the sender of a source channel's signal: it takes the event type, the source and the delivery key from the manifest of the submitting channel, and refuses with input_schema_invalid a signal whose event.type differs from that channel's ingress.event or whose sender is not hook:<source> of it (ING-4).

type.description: Event type: an event of the monitoring adapter (the first two branches), or from v0.2 the ingress.event of the source channel, always in ext.* (ING-4).

anyOf.description: The maintenance event of the monitoring adapter (MON-9).

data.description: Event data, checked by the core against the data schema of the type.
data.x-botaru-closed-by: the data schema of the event type in spec/bindings/events/catalog.yaml, or for a source channel the closed schemas of its ingress.mapping
